description: City of Greater Bendigo : Cycling - Everyday Rides is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Greater Bendigo. Everyday Bike Rides within the City of Greater Bendigo. Coverage: City of Greater Bendigo. The portal files it under the publisher City of Greater Bendigo. Its tags are Bendigo, Ride, bike, cycling. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, shp, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2024-11-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
